catoptromancy.definition:
n. A species of divination, which was performed by
   letting down a mirror into water, for a sick person to look at his face
   in it. If his countenance appeared distorted and ghastly, it was an ill
   omen; if fresh and healthy, it was favorable.

catoptron.definition: n. A reflecting optical glass or instrument; a mirror.
